items.title: Giants believe Brian Burns has torn ACL
items.body_text: Burns is expected to miss the rest of the season.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Seahawks disappointed, but "not down" after 12-game winning streak comes to an end
items.body_text: Sunday's loss to the Commanders was Seattle's first since November 16, 2025.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Ladd McConkey: If you don't think we can turn it around, then get out of here
items.body_text: If you looked at the box score for Sunday's game in Buffalo without checking the score first, you'd likely pick the Chargers as the team that wound up winning.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has to be smarter with the football
items.body_text: The Titans had the ball inside the Giants' 10-yard-line with 24 seconds left in Sunday's game, but any hopes of a comeback win were dashed when quarterback Cam Ward's final pass left his hand.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Lamar Jackson: I told Tyler Loop his legacy was starting now
items.body_text: Ravens kicker Tyler Loop's missed field goal at the end of the final regular season game of the 2025 season kept Baltimore out of the playoffs and it was on the mind of many as Sunday's game against the Cowboys in Rio reached its final moments.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Tyler Shough: I thought my arm was moving forward on fourth quarter fumble
items.body_text: The Saints were upset that they had a fumble recovery taken off the board in their Week 1 loss to the Lions and they weren't any happier about the application of the rules in the fourth quarter of Week 3.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Odell Beckham played 6 snaps, had 1 target and 0 catches
items.body_text: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said he wanted to get wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. more involved in the offense on Sunday.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Sean McVay didn't have much to say after Sunday night's loss
items.body_text: Anyone hoping to hear a detailed breakdown of why the Rams blew a 16-point halftime lead in Sunday night's loss to the Broncos was left disappointed by head coach Sean McVay's postgame press conference.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Sean Payton: We have to find a way to play better earlier
items.body_text: The Broncos were down 16-0 against the Rams at halftime on Sunday night, but they put up 30 points in the final 30 minutes to close out the game with their second straight win.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Buccaneers have lost an unprecedented 12 consecutive games against the spread
items.body_text: Betting against the Buccaneers is good business.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Matthew Stafford says "I've got to be better" after NFL-record 33rd career pick six
items.body_text: Talanoa Hufanga intercepted Stafford twice in the Broncos' 30-26 win over the Patriots.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Sunday Night Football: Broncos complete comeback, defeat Rams 30-26
items.body_text: Los Angeles was in it until the last play, but Denver was able to hang on for the team's second victory of the season.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Bo Nix throws two TD passes, two-point conversions, Broncos-Rams tied at 16-16
items.body_text: The Broncos were down 16-0 to the Rams at halftime.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Sunday Night Football: Rams lead Broncos 16-0 at halftime
items.body_text: Los Angeles scored on its last four possessions of the first half for a dominant first 30 minutes.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Deshaun Watson: I just wanted to finish the game for the fans
items.body_text: Browns fans booed Deshaun Watson in the second half of a preseason game against the Bills.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Matthew Stafford becomes first to throw for 20,000 yards with two NFL teams
items.body_text: Matthew Stafford has reached another milestone in his storied career.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Matthew Stafford TD pass gives Rams early 7-0 lead over Broncos
items.body_text: The Rams have taken an early 7-0 lead over the Broncos, but they are dealing with more injury issues.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Drake Maye attributes fumble to blood on the ball
items.body_text: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye had an unusual moment on Sunday, when he cocked his arm to throw and his hand came forward without the ball in it.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: John Harbaugh expects Jameis Winston to remain QB1 no matter who Giants add at the position
items.body_text: It wasn't pretty — and it was only the winless Titans — but Jameis Winston won his first game as a starter since Dec. 15, 2024, when he was with the Browns.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Deebo Samuel makes NFL history with 0 catches for 80 receiving yards and 1 TD
items.body_text: San Francisco wide receiver Deebo Samuel had a stat line never before seen in NFL history today: Zero catches, 80 receiving yards and a receiving touchdown.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Oregon says Dante Moore's CT scan and MRI were "clean"
items.body_text: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore, one of the top prospects in the 2027 draft, suffered a significant concussion on Saturday night, when he was knocked unconscious after sliding by USC linebacker Desman Stephens II.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Kyle Shanahan: We don't know nature of Mike Evans injury, will find out more Monday
items.body_text: The 49ers improved to 3-0 against the Cardinals on Sunday, but their list of injured players got a little longer.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Kirk Cousins throws 3 TDs, Raiders move to 3-0 with 35-27 victory over Saints
items.body_text: For just the second time since 2002, the Raiders are 3-0.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Kevin O'Connell: Justin Jefferson "got close" to returning, ankle to be evaluated Monday
items.body_text: Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson left Sunday's game in the first quarter with an ankle injury and did not return before the end of Minnesota's 23-16 win over the Buccaneers.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Baker Mayfield dislocated his thumb, will have an MRI
items.body_text: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield had to leave Sunday's loss to the Vikings late in the fourth quarter and medical tests will help determine when he's able to return.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Ravens beat Cowboys 34-31 on final play in Brazil
items.body_text: The Ravens had only 7 seconds when they got the ball back, but one play got Tyler Loop in position for 56-yard FG.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Vikings beat Bucs 23-16, Baker Mayfield injured late in game
items.body_text: The Vikings won't be thrilled with how their offense performed in Sunday's 23-16 win over the Buccaneers, but they had plenty to like on defense.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: 49ers improve to 3-0 with hard-fought win over Cardinals
items.body_text: It wasn't as easy as expected, but San Francisco managed to win at home against Arizona.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Cowboys take 28-24 lead after fourth-down stop of Ravens
items.body_text: The Cowboys were dead in the water, thisclose to being down 10 points.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Sunday Night Football: Marvin Mims, Puka Nacua inactive for Broncos-Rams
items.body_text: Both the Rams and Broncos will be without a key receiver on Sunday night in Week 3.
items.author: Myles Simmons
